name: Cat Ba
provinceNote: Nghị quyết 1669/NQ-UBTVQH15 of 16 June 2025 set up Đặc khu Cát Hải. The park’s contact line puts Vườn quốc gia Cát Bà in that zone, in Hải Phòng.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: An island off Hai Phong with a harbour town, a forested national park and boat trips into Lan Ha Bay. Cruise among the limestone islets, hike in the park where the langur lives, and eat seafood by the kilo on the harbour front. Two nights suits travellers who want the karst bays from an island base.
fee: No single town ticket. From 1 January 2026 a bay day is 120,000 đồng for an adult and 60,000 for a child from 6, and the park is 160,000 / 80,000. Under 6 is free. The 2024 resolution uses the same prices and also counts a child from 1.2 m. Boat hire, Cannon Fort, and Hospital Cave: Check on arrival.
getThere: Ferry Đồng Bài–Cái Viềng. From 1 September through 31 December 2026 the pier opens at 05:00 and the posted day runs to 18:00.
bestMonths: April–June for calm water; autumn light; winter walks
seoTitle: Cat Ba travel guide — a Lan Ha boat, the park, and the harbor
seoDescription: A boat from Bến Bèo through Lan Ha, then the national park and the harbor town. Kayaks, the langur, the beaches, and the walks up to the peaks.
intro: You are on a boat in Lan Ha, limestone off the water east of Cát Bà, with the national park on the island and the harbor as the town you come back to. A kayak takes the low passage at Hang Luồn. The walks up to Kim Giao and Ngự Lâm, and the path out to Việt Hải, are the climbs. Cát Cò 1, 2, and 3 are the swims on the town side.

Stay if that boat, the park, and a room above the harbor are the trip. Go to Ha Long if the cruise from that pier is the trip. The usual day leaves Bến Bèo for about 3–4 hours: vịnh Cái Bèo, a fish raft or đảo Ba Trái Đào, a swim at đảo Khỉ, then back. An 8-hour day and overnight boats run the same bay.

The other morning is Cat Ba National Park. The gate is 07:00 to 17:00, in the limestone forest where the golden-headed langur, Trachypithecus poliocephalus, lives and is critically endangered. From 1 January 2026 an adult park ticket is 160,000 đồng and a child from 6 is 80,000, with under 6 free. The 2024 resolution uses those same prices and also draws the child line at 1.2 m.

Sleep in thị trấn Cát Bà, on the harbor, and eat that night on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc. One address also places the Núi Ngọc food street in thị trấn Cát Hải. After dinner the night market sells sea souvenirs. The ferry is Đồng Bài–Cái Viềng: from 1 September through 31 December 2026 the pier opens at 05:00 and the posted day runs to 18:00. The mistake is to treat a Ha Long cruise, or the lunar boat race in Cát Hải town, as this harbor.
gettingAround: The island ferry is Đồng Bài–Cái Viềng. A pedestrian ticket is 10,000 đồng a crossing, a bicycle 12,000, a loaded bicycle 12,000, a motorbike 45,000, a car under 9 seats 190,000, a coach of 9 to under 24 seats 210,000, a coach of 24 to under 32 seats 240,000, and a coach of 32 seats and up 330,000. Truck fares run from 145,000 to 970,000 by weight and load. From 1 April 2026, pupils and students who live or study in the special zone ride free. Vietnamese residents of the zone pay half for a walking ticket, a bicycle, a loaded bicycle, and a motorbike. A car under 9 seats gets that half only if a resident owns it and it is not in the transport business. A card and an identity paper are required.

From 1 September 2026 through 31 December 2026 the pier opens at 05:00 and the posted day runs to 18:00. Weather or a crowd can extend it to 19:00. The first boat leaves Cái Viềng at 05:00 and reaches Đồng Bài at 05:30. The last leaves at 17:30 and arrives opposite at 18:00. Those two crossings take 30 minutes. Boats alternate, generally every 30–40 minutes, and a departure can move, with at most 40 minutes between boats. Cars and trucks heading onto Cát Bà are not taken from 09:00 to 13:00 on 25 April 2026 through 3 May 2026, and on weekend holidays from 9 May 2026 through 30 September 2026.

Coaches from bến xe Nước Ngầm or bến xe Gia Lâm run every 15–20 minutes toward bến Bính, then a boat. That crossing is about 30,000 đồng a person, which is not the Đồng Bài fare and not a Bến Bèo boat hire. Cát Bi, in Hải Phòng, is the airport on that route. There is no station on the island. Ga Hải Phòng is the rail stop.

Hà Nội departures and Hải Phòng arrivals: HP1 06:00 to 08:25, LP3 09:25 to 12:00, LP5 15:15 to 18:00, LP7 18:10 to 20:55, and LP9 07:15 to 10:07. HP1 is 2 hours 25 minutes on that row. The other rows differ. HP15 leaves Hải Dương at 06:20 and reaches Hải Phòng at 07:17, with no Hà Nội time on that row. Return departures from Hải Phòng: LP2 06:05, LP6 09:10, LP8 15:00, HP2 18:40, LP10 16:20, HP16 17:30. LP7 and LP8 run to or from Hà Nội on Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. LP9 runs Saturday. LP10 runs Sunday. HP15 and HP16 run Monday to Friday. The office is 75 Lương Khánh Thiện, phường Gia Viên.

Gia Luận is the northern pier toward Tuần Châu, about 20 km from thị trấn Cát Bà through the national park. The zone sits about 30 km by sea from the Hải Phòng city center. Cáp treo Cát Hải–Phù Long crosses toward Phù Long, and cầu Tân Vũ–Lạch Huyện is 15.6 km, the mainland approach to Cát Hải. On the island, bay boats leave Bến Bèo. Bến Bèo is 1.5 km from the town center, or about 2 km by road. The bay ticket is separate from the boat. The fort is a few kilometres from the town center, or about 10 minutes.

stayAreas.name: Cat Ba town harbor
stayAreas.summary: Rooms along the seawall in thị trấn Cát Bà, with the boats and the limestone hill in front of you.

eat: Seafood by weight is the meal on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc: cá song, bề bề, tu hài, ngao Phù Long, gà Liên Minh, mật ong rừng, cam Gia Luận, khoai sọ Hiền Hào, and nước mắm Cát Hải, plus the rest of the harbor list.
interestsBody: Dining is the harbor meal: seafood by weight on đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, then honey, Cát Hải fish sauce, Liên Minh chicken, Gia Luận oranges, and Hiền Hào taro.
Chợ Cát Bà is the town market under the gate. After dinner the night market sells sea souvenirs.
Lan Ha is the boat from Bến Bèo, east of the island, with a kayak through Hang Luồn and its own ticket. It is not a cruise from the Ha Long pier.
The park is the forest morning. The gate is 07:00 to 17:00, and the golden-headed langur lives in this archipelago. The walks go up to Kim Giao and Ngự Lâm and out to Việt Hải.
Cát Cò 1, 2, and 3, Tùng Thu, Cát Dứa, Vạn Bội, and Các Bà are the swims. Cannon Fort and Hospital Cave are the wartime stops above the harbor and on the cross-island road.

blocks.heading: Chợ Cát Bà
paragraphs: The town market stands under the gate that reads Chợ Cát Bà. Seafood kitchens use that gate as an address, one without a town name and one in thị trấn Cát Hải. After dinner, the night market is where you buy sea souvenirs.

blocks.heading: The Lan Ha floating market
paragraphs: On the boat, the floating market in vịnh Lan Hạ is smaller than a Mekong floating market and is mostly the fish-raft keepers. You can buy seafood there to take home.

interestGroups.title: Lan Ha Bay
interestGroups.summary: A boat from Bến Bèo into the bay east of the island, with a kayak through Hang Luồn. The ticket is not a Ha Long cruise fare.

cards.title: Lan Ha Bay
cards.summary: Limestone and water east of Cát Bà. The hire starts and ends at Bến Bèo.

blocks.heading: The boat from Bến Bèo
paragraphs: From 1 January 2026 a day on the bays is 120,000 đồng for an adult and 60,000 for a child from 6, with under 6 free. One night is 400,000 / 300,000, two nights 600,000 / 500,000, and three nights 650,000 / 550,000. The collector keeps 21 percent and pays 79 percent to the state budget. The 2024 resolution uses the same adult and child prices. Its paying child is from age 6 or from 1.2 m, and its free line is under 6 or under 1.2 m. It also kept 21 percent. Boat hire is separate.

April to June is calm and clear for boats, and from September the bay is quiet. Autumn light is the other season people come for. Dive spots on this bay are 4–5 m deep. Đảo Khỉ, also called Cát Dứa, is a stop on the 3–4 hour hire, about 2 km of sea from the approach, with two beaches, Cát Dứa 1 and 2. Rangers stocked it with more than 20 monkeys. Cát Dứa beach is the finest of the satellite beaches.

Hang Luồn is the kayak passage. Làng chài Cửa Vạn sits against the limestone called Vạ Giá, and more than 300 families fish there. The floating village at Cái Bèo has more than 200 households, and another count says about 300. The prehistoric site was found in 1938, dated about 7,000 to 4,500 years ago. A December 2008 dig found pottery at 2.6 m dated about 7,000–7,500 years, and the ministry ranked the site national in February 2009. A 2013 line still says that ranking is still to come. Vạn Bội and Vạn Hà are the coral beaches. Bãi tắm mới Các Bà is the newer swim in the central bay.

Cát Cò 1, 2, and 3 are the town-side swims. The fort looks down on Cát Cò 1 and 2. Tùng Thu is named with those swims. A paper-flower road runs along the coast for more than 20 km, called the finest coastal road in the north. Lan Ha itself is more than 7,000 ha, about 400 islands, and 139 small yellow beaches. UNESCO’s English synthesis for the whole property is 65,650 ha and 1,133 islands; other-language lines on the same listing say about 1,600 islands.

cards.title: Cat Ba National Park
cards.summary: Limestone under forest. Gate 07:00–17:00. Adult park ticket 160,000 đồng from 1 January 2026.

blocks.heading: The gate and the routes
paragraphs: The archipelago was designated a national park in 1986, a marine protected area in 2010, and a special national monument in 2013. The park boundary should still be aligned with the World Heritage boundary. The biosphere reserve dates from 2004, and the property extension is September 2023, criteria (vii) and (viii). The golden-headed langur lives only here and is critically endangered on the IUCN Red List.

From 1 January 2026, adult and child from 6: the park 160,000 / 80,000; the line from the park center to đỉnh Kim Giao, đỉnh Ngự Lâm, and động Trung Trang 120,000 / 60,000; đồng Ninh Tiếp and hang Tiền Đức 80,000 / 40,000; Phù Long, the mangrove, and động Thiên Long 80,000 / 40,000. Under 6 is free. Those fees are paid entirely to the state budget. The 2024 text, now replaced, said the park keeps what it collects, at the same prices. The child test also disagrees, as on the bay ticket: the 2024 line pays from age 6 or from 1.2 m, and is free under 6 or under 1.2 m. The gate is 07:00–17:00.

Động Trung Trang is on that route, about 300 m through the hill, with the Kim Giao forest at the site. Trung Trang valley is the largest on the island, about 300 ha, 10 to 30 m below sea level. The cave is 15 km northwest of thị trấn Cát Bà. Việt Hải is the fishing village on the Lan Ha shore. The trek title is “Ao Ếch – Việt Hải (12km)”. The village is under 18 km from the district center. The walk via Ao Ếch is given as more than 8 km, and also as 8 km. In summer Ao Ếch is a freshwater pool. In the dry season the bed is firm, slightly springy, and damp, and you can walk on it. About 80 houses are bamboo, wood, leaves, and earth.

Pháo đài Thần Công, cao điểm 177, was built in 1942. The gun on show is a damaged display piece, not a gun that fought. It is a few kilometres from the town center, or about 10 minutes. In 2013 a ticket was 40,000 đồng and a coffee 100,000. Hang Quân Y, older name Hùng Sơn, is the field hospital used in 1963–1965: about 200 m, three levels, 17 rooms. It is about 7 km from the center of Cát Bà, and another measure says about 13 km. Động Hoa Cương, from 1 January 2026, is 30,000 đồng for an adult and 15,000 for a child from 6. The collector keeps 21 percent and pays 79 percent to the budget. The 2024 text had the same amounts, placed the cave at xã Gia Luận, and said that commune pays its fee entirely to the budget.

season.label: Calm water, autumn light, winter walks
season.note: April to June is calm and clear for boats, and from September Lan Ha is quiet. Autumn light is the other season for the bay. Winter beaches are thin of crowds, for hiking, a kayak, and the walk to Việt Hải. The ferry day can move with the weather. Cars and trucks heading onto the island are paused 09:00–13:00 on 25 April–3 May 2026 and on weekend holidays from 9 May through 30 September 2026. The posted ferry clock runs 1 September–31 December 2026. The visit anniversary is 31 March 1959. The 2026 seafood fair ran 25 March–2 April at Trung tâm du lịch Cát Bà. Đền Hiền Hào is lunar 12/1. Xa mã đình Hoàng Châu is lunar 10/6, and that gate is not in this harbor. The Cát Hải town boat race is lunar 21/1 in that other town. Dragon boats on Cát Bà are 1 April, a solar date, not that lunar race.

faqs.q: How do you reach Cat Ba?
faqs.a: The island ferry is Đồng Bài–Cái Viềng. From 1 September through 31 December 2026 the pier opens at 05:00 and the posted day runs to 18:00, extendable to 19:00. The first boat leaves Cái Viềng at 05:00 and reaches Đồng Bài at 05:30. The last leaves at 17:30 and arrives opposite at 18:00. A pedestrian ticket is 10,000 đồng. The about 30,000 đồng figure is the bến Bính crossing, not this fare. Train to Ga Hải Phòng first. HP1 is 06:00 to 08:25. Other rows differ. Gia Luận, about 20 km through the park, is the northern pier toward Tuần Châu.
On the harbor strip in thị trấn Cát Bà, above the seawall, so the boats and the limestone are the morning. Cát Hải town is the other island’s town, not this base.

faqs.q: Is a Lan Ha day the same as a Ha Long cruise?
faqs.a: No. The boat leaves Bến Bèo and stays in the bay east of Cát Bà. Ha Long and the Cát Bà archipelago are one property and two management boards. The overnight bay fees are for nights on the Cát Bà bays. They are not a Ha Long cruise fare.

faqs.q: What do the tickets cost, and who counts as a child?
faqs.a: From 1 January 2026 a bay day is 120,000 đồng for an adult and 60,000 for a child from 6, and the park is 160,000 / 80,000. Under 6 is free. The 2024 resolution uses the same amounts and also treats 1.2 m as the child line: paying from age 6 or from 1.2 m, free under 6 or under 1.2 m. The park gate is 07:00–17:00. Boat hire is separate from the bay ticket.
